growth_signal.value: Revenue grew 300% over two years and headcount tripled; now works with over 1,000 factories worldwide.

raised.note: confirmed by two sources in the run; the URLs were not saved

entry.idea: Pelico gives factory teams one shared, real-time view of their production data so they can spot part shortages and bottlenecks before they cause delays.
entry.lesson: Give scattered teams one shared source of truth for a messy, high-stakes process and they will pay to avoid costly delays.
entry.name: Pelico

growth.reason: Revenue tripled roughly, growing 300% in two years, with headcount tripling too and clear customer numbers.

market.reason: Manufacturing supply chain problems affect a huge, worldwide industrial base, not just one country.

tech.reason: It is a strong data and workflow platform, but the core idea could be matched by another well-funded team within a year or two.

entry.twist: It uses AI to suggest fixes and run simulations, and gets different teams on the factory floor collaborating around the same live data instead of separate spreadsheets.
entry.who_pays: Large industrial manufacturers, including aerospace and defense companies, pay to run their factories through the platform.
entry.why_now: Supply chains are still unpredictable after recent global disruptions, and factories want to react to shortages in hours, not weeks.
